name: ejo100
description: EJO 100 Enterprise Platform - reusable Enterprise Operating System (EnterpriseOS)

scripts.brand:sync: cp packages/enyo/src/brand.ts apps/portal/lib/brand.ts && cp packages/enyo/src/brand.ts apps/website/lib/brand.ts
scripts.vercel:portal: npm install --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npx prisma generate --schema=packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run build --workspace=packages/database && node scripts/db-push-if-vercel.js && node scripts/seed-if-vercel.js && npm run build --workspace=apps/portal
scripts.vercel:website: npm install --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npx prisma generate --schema=packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run build --workspace=packages/database && npm run build --workspace=apps/website
